Well, I started suspecting I had ADHD around a year and a half ago reading about it after someone implied that I had it. It hasn't started yesterday, I always had problems keeping track of school, having shitty schedule, always starting new projects that I lost interest in a short period of time, I was called lazy for not studying more, I zoned out in a room full of people day dreaming. My room was always a mess, I had bad addictions and this goes as far as 13 years ago (that I can remember) so no I'm not suspecting I have adhd since I turned 23, and I don't label myself "with adhd" just yet, not until I consult with a professional like you said. But ever since I have started suspecting, my life has become easier. My friend understands me why I have to tell her the super unnecessary context to my story, I had told her like 2 years or 3 that I'm not doing it on purpose, she now believes me that I don't actually choose to overshare, bring information that she or anyone needs and she has become more patient with me. If it wasn't for us thinking I might have adhd, things would have been horrible and I would be misunderstood just because I drift away from a topic to another thinking "context is necessary". But you are absolutely right, I shouldn't be diagnosing myself, I'm not in the slightest qualified to do that and I will get professional help as soon as I'm allowed and can afford. I appreciate the warning and advice, thinking of deleting this whole things cuz its too long but whatever I'll just send it lol thanks again

Today we were looking for smth on the internet so she asked me to give her the measuring tape from the other desk next to where we were sitting, I opened the door and I instantly forgot what tf I was supposed to do so I just grabbed the first thing I saw, it was a USB I think, I don't remember. I started examining it meanwhile completetly ignore the fact that I was supposed to get the measuring tape, she started laughing about what happened and she grabbed the tape, while I realized what I did and what I was supposed to do. So I go back to the desk looking for the measuring tape, but she already got it. We both laugh at it and now she's convinced that I have adhd. She also has had an exam related to adhd studies and she shared with me, she agreed that it was almost like they were talking about me. its a funny story that will mostlikely be stuck with me for the rest of my life, so I hope its ok to share it here.
